newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuantan Flour to buy construction firm.
newsitem.headline: Kuantan Flour to buy construction firm.

text.p: Malaysia's Kuantan Flour Mills Bhd said on Friday it has proposed to acquire the entire paid-up capital of Strategic Alliance Construction Sdn Bhd for 110 million ringgit cash.

The company also planned a one-for-one rights issue of 23.94 million new shares at 3.80 ringgit per share and a special issue of 10.53 million shares to bumiputra (ethnic Malay) investors also at 3.80 ringgit each, Kuantan Flour said in a statement.

It said the acquisition of Strategic Alliance, which is involved in construction of infrastructure works, and residential and commercial buildings, would be financed by proceeds from the rights and special issues.
Strategic Alliance currently has about 640 million ringgit worth of contracts in hand, the statement said.
